question: Among observations with at least two non-overlapping sibling peers, which physically different anonymous occupant families repeatedly appear in nearly the same masked relational role among siblings across independent sources?

excluded: sibling count as a role feature

robustStandardization.reason: prevent rare physical outliers from becoming artificial occupant families or dominating continuous context distance

occupantClustering.selection: discard the 5% most extreme clipped train topology vectors from centroid discovery only, then choose highest deterministic sampled silhouette among supported multi-family solutions; lower k breaks ties; all observations are assigned afterward

substitutionTest.physicalDifferenceGate: occupant centroid distance at or above median supported-family pair distance
substitutionTest.primaryContextMetric: symmetric median nearest-neighbor masked-role distance with every match forced across sourceGroupId
substitutionTest.withinFamilyBaseline: same metric within each physical family with self and same-source matches forbidden
substitutionTest.trainSelection: smallest geometry cross-family distance ratio to pooled within-family baseline, then augmented-context ratio, among physically separated supported families
substitutionTest.transfer: same physical families and frozen train standardization evaluated unchanged in holdout and control

falsifiers.coarseGeometryOnly: If a pair matches in geometry but not when non-overlapping sibling topology is included, simple spatial role is insufficient.
falsifiers.noCrossSourceMatch: If physically different families do not approach their own within-family masked-context spread across independent sources, substitution is unsupported.
falsifiers.transferFailure: If train-selected pairs do not remain unusually close in both Bavaria and LOC, the apparent sibling-role substitution is not transferable.
